look_here_first: Inspect the yellow flower head and sticky involucral bracts (phyllaries), then the stems: yellow ray florets surround a disk; many phyllary tips hook or curve back; stems are noticeably hairy/glandular. Check serrate leaves clasping the stem.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Latest deep-review queue confirms Uvalde; additional target-zone counties remain unverified. Williamson records do not count toward the project's target zone.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Do not treat a single target-zone county as a 3-county PASS; historical gumweed synonyms need concept-level review.

morphology_keys.life_cycle: Herbaceous gumweed; confirm longevity on mature plants rather than relying on habit alone.
best_field_traits: Yellow ray florets present around yellow disk florets (radiate head).
Numerous phyllaries with hooked/recurved resinous tips.
Stems visibly hairy or glandular-hairy, especially toward the heads.
Alternate serrate leaves with sessile/clasping bases.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Versus G. ciliata, compare stem pubescence (adenodonta hairier; ciliata usually otherwise glabrous/gland-dotted), annual habit, and mature pappus. G. nuda is typically rayless; do not infer a radiate specimen is nuda. G. squarrosa has strongly squarrose recurved phyllaries, but historical var. nuda records belong to a different current taxon. G. lanceolata has narrower leaves; use a mature head and stem together.
comparisons.warning: A phyllary photo alone may not reliably split all radiate gumweeds; confirm multiple structures.
